material_peer_challenges.claim: The child units are preserved, but a flat row reading can obscure the paired-annunciation, paired-birth/song, presentation, and childhood macrostructure; a stable peer hold requires an explicit parent-child response.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.1.5-Luke.2.52; CHILD ROUTE Luke.1.5-Luke.1.25 | Luke.1.26-Luke.1.38 | Luke.1.39-Luke.1.56 | Luke.1.57-Luke.1.66 | Luke.1.67-Luke.1.80 | Luke.2.1-Luke.2.20 | Luke.2.21-Luke.2.24 | Luke.2.25-Luke.2.40 | Luke.2.41-Luke.2.52
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the paired-panel parent and every listed child seam. Preserve each route and do not split a song from its narrative frame; later hierarchy change requires separate authorization.

material_peer_challenges.claim: The four local movements are preserved but materially depend on the complete plain-discourse parent; atomizing blessings, imperatives, judgment sayings, or builders would lose address and rhetorical progression.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.6.20-Luke.6.49; CHILD ROUTE Luke.6.20-Luke.6.26 | Luke.6.27-Luke.6.36 | Luke.6.37-Luke.6.42 | Luke.6.43-Luke.6.49
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the parent and four-child route and explain why no seam severs audience, address, analogy, or closure. Preserve the complete parent in later hierarchy.

material_peer_challenges.claim: The candidate keeps the intercalation whole, but the A-B-A relation is a material dependency that must stay explicit so the embedded woman episode is neither detached nor allowed to erase the Jairus frame.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.8.40-Luke.8.56; CHILD ROUTE A Luke.8.40-Luke.8.42 | B Luke.8.43-Luke.8.48 | A-prime Luke.8.49-Luke.8.56
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the A-B-A analysis and preserve both the whole parent and exact three-part alternative. Do not promote the child route without a later authorized ruling.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Luke.9.51 is a journey turn, not a self-sufficient verse atom, while mission, lawyer, household, and prayer episodes remain complete children. The route needs an explicit journey-subparent response.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.9.51-Luke.11.13; CHILD ROUTE Luke.9.51-Luke.9.56 | Luke.9.57-Luke.9.62 | Luke.10.1-Luke.10.24 | Luke.10.25-Luke.10.37 | Luke.10.38-Luke.10.42 | Luke.11.1-Luke.11.13
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the journey-subparent and explain 9.50|9.51, 10.24|10.25, and 11.13|11.14. Keep the journey notice with the Samaritan episode and retain exact alternatives.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Controversy, meal woes, warnings, repentance, healing, kingdom comparisons, narrow-door teaching, and lament are defensible children, but the long-journey middle remains a material parent whose continuity must not flatten speaker, setting, and genre resets.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.11.14-Luke.13.35; CHILD ROUTE Luke.11.14-Luke.11.28 | Luke.11.29-Luke.11.36 | Luke.11.37-Luke.11.54 | Luke.12.1-Luke.12.12 | Luke.12.13-Luke.12.34 | Luke.12.35-Luke.12.48 | Luke.12.49-Luke.12.59 | Luke.13.1-Luke.13.9 | Luke.13.10-Luke.13.17 | Luke.13.18-Luke.13.21 | Luke.13.22-Luke.13.30 | Luke.13.31-Luke.13.35
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must respond to the full parent and route, specifically the 11.37-54 meal frame and 13.21|13.22 and 13.30|13.31 seams. Preserve rather than collapse local units.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Meal, crowd, lost-and-found, wealth, reversal, and discipleship units are preserved, but shared frames materially constrain seams: the Sabbath meal extends through banquet teaching, the complaint frames the lost sequence, and question or audience frames stay with replies.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.14.1-Luke.17.10; CHILD ROUTE Luke.14.1-Luke.14.14 | Luke.14.15-Luke.14.24 | Luke.14.25-Luke.14.35 | Luke.15.1-Luke.15.10 | Luke.15.11-Luke.15.32 | Luke.16.1-Luke.16.13 | Luke.16.14-Luke.16.18 | Luke.16.19-Luke.16.31 | Luke.17.1-Luke.17.10; MEAL SUBPARENT Luke.14.1-Luke.14.24
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut both parents and address 14.24|14.25, 15.10|15.11, 16.13|16.14, and 16.18|16.19 without theological or policy adjudication.

material_peer_challenges.claim: The final travel block has real interlocutor and form resets, yet border journey, kingdom discourse, prayer parables, wealth encounters, Jericho scenes, and minas remain within a material journey-subparent that must not turn narrative order into chronology.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.17.11-Luke.19.27; CHILD ROUTE Luke.17.11-Luke.17.19 | Luke.17.20-Luke.17.37 | Luke.18.1-Luke.18.8 | Luke.18.9-Luke.18.14 | Luke.18.15-Luke.18.17 | Luke.18.18-Luke.18.30 | Luke.18.31-Luke.18.34 | Luke.18.35-Luke.18.43 | Luke.19.1-Luke.19.10 | Luke.19.11-Luke.19.27
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the parent and exact route and defend 17.19|17.20, 18.30|18.31, 18.34|18.35, and 19.27|19.28. Journey linkage remains literary evidence only.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Approach, entry, lament, temple action, controversies, warning, and widow scene are locally complete, but the approach-to-temple transition and daily temple frame create a material parent across chapters; the widow scene needs the competing preceding-warning frame.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.19.28-Luke.21.4; CHILD ROUTE Luke.19.28-Luke.19.40 | Luke.19.41-Luke.19.44 | Luke.19.45-Luke.19.48 | Luke.20.1-Luke.20.8 | Luke.20.9-Luke.20.19 | Luke.20.20-Luke.20.26 | Luke.20.27-Luke.20.40 | Luke.20.41-Luke.20.44 | Luke.20.45-Luke.20.47 | Luke.21.1-Luke.21.4; TEMPLE SUBPARENT Luke.19.45-Luke.21.4
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut both parents and explain 19.44|19.45, 19.48|20.1, and 20.47|21.1. Preserve local speakers and bar collective-guilt or harmonizing inferences.

material_peer_challenges.claim: The temple discourse has three defensible rows, but the initiating remark and question, warning movements, fig analogy, watchfulness, and daily-teaching close require an explicit complete-discourse parent and must not be synchronized into a timetable.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.21.5-Luke.21.38; CHILD ROUTE Luke.21.5-Luke.21.19 | Luke.21.20-Luke.21.28 | Luke.21.29-Luke.21.38; FINER ALTERNATIVE Luke.21.5-Luke.21.7 | Luke.21.8-Luke.21.19 | Luke.21.20-Luke.21.24 | Luke.21.25-Luke.21.28 | Luke.21.29-Luke.21.33 | Luke.21.34-Luke.21.36 | Luke.21.37-Luke.21.38
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the parent and both routes, address 21.4|21.5 and 21.36|21.37, and keep eschatological, chronological, and harmonizing claims outside the ruling.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Preparation, meal, betrayal inquiry, greatness dispute, service and kingdom sayings, Peter forecast, and mission-equipment exchange form a materially linked passion-meal sequence. Local children are defensible, but the meal and farewell parent stays explicit and variant-neutral.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.22.1-Luke.22.38; PREPARATION ROUTE Luke.22.1-Luke.22.6 | Luke.22.7-Luke.22.13; MEAL-FAREWELL SUBPARENT Luke.22.14-Luke.22.38 with CHILD ROUTE Luke.22.14-Luke.22.23 | Luke.22.24-Luke.22.34 | Luke.22.35-Luke.22.38
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the meal-farewell parent and defend 22.23|22.24 and 22.34|22.35 without using Luke.22.19-20 variants to create or suppress a seam.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Prayer, arrest, denial, mockery, and council hearing are distinct movements within continuous passion custody. Candidate seams are defensible but materially held for continuity, setting resets, and textual hot zones.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.22.39-Luke.22.71; CHILD ROUTE Luke.22.39-Luke.22.46 | Luke.22.47-Luke.22.53 | Luke.22.54-Luke.22.62 | Luke.22.63-Luke.22.71; FINER HEARING ROUTE Luke.22.63-Luke.22.65 | Luke.22.66-Luke.22.71
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the routes; address 22.38|22.39, 22.53|22.54, 22.62|22.63, and 22.65|22.66; and show Luke.22.43-44 and 22.64 variants do not determine a boundary.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Pilate opening, Herod referral and return, and Pilate resolution are distinct hearings inside one material trial-sentence sequence. Referral as either total break or no break requires author justification.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.23.1-Luke.23.25; CHILD ROUTE Luke.23.1-Luke.23.5 | Luke.23.6-Luke.23.12 | Luke.23.13-Luke.23.25; COARSER ALTERNATIVE Luke.23.1-Luke.23.12 | Luke.23.13-Luke.23.25
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the parent and both routes and address 23.5|23.6 and 23.12|23.13. Luke.23.15 and 23.17 variants may be flagged but must not select the route.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Procession, crucifixion dialogue, death and witnesses, and burial are distinct children of one material passion close. Witness continuity competes with action and time resets, while textual hot zones remain boundary-neutral.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.23.26-Luke.23.56; CHILD ROUTE Luke.23.26-Luke.23.31 | Luke.23.32-Luke.23.43 | Luke.23.44-Luke.23.49 | Luke.23.50-Luke.23.56
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the parent and route, address 23.31|23.32, 23.43|23.44, and 23.49|23.50, and show Luke.23.34, 23.42, and 23.45 variants neither create nor suppress seams.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Tomb report, road recognition, Jerusalem appearance and commission, and departure close are distinct children of a same-day literary macro-parent. The route is defensible but materially held because transitions compete with broader alternatives and variant-sensitive clauses.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: PARENT Luke.24.1-Luke.24.53; CHILD ROUTE Luke.24.1-Luke.24.12 | Luke.24.13-Luke.24.35 | Luke.24.36-Luke.24.49 | Luke.24.50-Luke.24.53; COARSER ALTERNATIVES Luke.24.1-Luke.24.49 | Luke.24.36-Luke.24.53
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must affirm or rebut the parent, route, and alternatives; address 24.12|24.13, 24.35|24.36, and 24.49|24.50; and keep variants from selecting witness, reading, chronology, or boundary.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Every boundary intersecting a textual or translation hot zone remains under a material invariance hold: a variant may be recorded as evidence but may not create, suppress, or authorize a seam.
material_peer_challenges.exact_alternative: VARIANT-INVARIANT ALTERNATIVE: retain every current candidate span intersecting the listed hot zones unchanged under every unresolved reading; record finer or larger routes only as exact alternatives and select no witness, reading, translation, punctuation, or chronology.
material_peer_challenges.remedy: Author must respond passage by passage or adopt the invariant rule globally, confirming no listed hot zone supplied a deciding boundary marker. Any exception requires independent textual review and separate authorization.
